title: Polynomial-Time Bounded Iteration
statement: Let $g$ and $u$ be polynomial-time computable functions from finite Boolean words to finite Boolean words. Let $a,k,B,b$ be natural numbers, and suppose that for every word $z$ and every natural number $i$ with $i\le a(|z|+1)^k$, the word obtained by applying $g$ successively $i$ times to $u(z)$ has length at most $B(|z|+1)^b$. Then the function sending $z$ to the result of applying $g$ successively $a(|z|+1)^k$ times to $u(z)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: For every $z$ and $i\le a(|z|+1)^k$, the indicated iterate has length at most $B(|z|+1)^b$
